Enterprise IT Support Frequently Asked Questions &
Knowledge Base
Login & MFA Troubleshooting, GlobalProtect VPN, Hardware Docks, and License Provisioning
Classification: Internal
Version: 3.0
Owner: Global IT Helpdesk
Support Hotline: +1-888-273-9487 (x4357)
1. Login, Credentials, and Multi-Factor Authentication
Q1: How do I reset my expired or forgotten Okta password?
Navigate to https://apex.okta.com and click "Need help signing in? -> Reset Password". Follow the verification
prompt sent to your registered secondary authentication method. If your account is locked due to five (5) consecutive
invalid attempts, contact the IT Helpdesk via Slack at #help-it or phone extension x4357.
Q2: What should I do if I lose or misplace my YubiKey hardware token?
Immediately report the lost YubiKey to IT Security via email ( security@apextech.internal ) so the token's
cryptographic certificate can be revoked. Visit the IT Desktop Support bar in Building B (or request a replacement via the
Self-Service Portal for remote employees) to be issued a temporary TOTP emergency bypass code and a replacement
YubiKey.
2. Network Connectivity and GlobalProtect VPN
Q3: How do I connect to the corporate Wi-Fi in regional offices?
Select the Enterprise-Secure SSID. When prompted, select WPA3 Enterprise (EAP-TLS) authentication. Your pre-
provisioned corporate MacBook or ThinkPad has the device machine certificate pre-installed; click Connect and trust the
internal Root CA.
Q4: My GlobalProtect VPN fails to connect with "Gateway Not Reachable". What do I do?
Verify that your home broadband allows outbound UDP traffic on ports 4500 and 500 (IPsec). In the GlobalProtect menu,
select Settings -> Gateways and toggle between vpn-primary.apextech.com and vpn-secondary.apextech.com . If
issues persist, flush your local DNS cache ( sudo dscacheutil -flushcache on macOS).
3. Hardware, Peripherals, and Software Licensing
Q5: My external dual monitors do not display when plugged into the USB-C dock.
Ensure the CalDigit TS4 docking station power brick is securely plugged in. On macOS, navigate to System Settings ->
Displays and verify that "Mirror Displays" is disabled. On Windows, press Win + P and select "Extend".
Q6: How do I request commercial software licenses (PyCharm Professional, Copilot, Figma)?
Visit the Apex Self-Service Portal ( https://software.internal.apextech.com ). Search for the requested tool and
submit a license request. Approvals are automatically routed to your department manager; licenses are provisioned to
your Okta dashboard within 4 hours of manager approval.
